opt.title: ClearFlow · Settings
opt.useJev: Use Jev for replies the local rules can't decide
opt.dup: The same line from several accounts
opt.sloganHint: Replies you hid yourself, and ones where you clicked the funnel on a notice bar. The exact same line is hidden anywhere; your 10 most recent are also sent to TypeSafe as examples, along with the comments you're viewing, to catch the same kind of spam elsewhere.
opt.abuseHint: Insults and attacks aimed at a person; criticizing what was said doesn't count. Plenty of arguing replies under hot news posts get hidden; pick Relaxed if that's too many.
opt.sexualHint: Explicit descriptions, sexual slang, porn links and hookup offers count; tasteful talk about relationships, sexual health information and swearing used for emphasis don't. Coded slang isn't always recognized.
opt.imagesHint: When on, replies with images (X, Reddit, RedNote) go to Jev together with their images, so ads, QR codes and sexual pictures inside images can be caught; replies that are only an image get checked too. Each image is shrunk to 768 px first and costs roughly 1,000–2,000 extra tokens. Jev's image reading is still experimental and less accurate than its text reading. Your browser will ask whether to let the extension read images from these sites.
opt.imagesDenied: Image access wasn't granted, so images stay off.
opt.recThreshold: Threshold on posts asking for recommendations
opt.bannerRatio: Show the “mostly bots” notice when the share of spam in the first replies exceeds
opt.cacheMB: Local cache limit for filtering results (Jev), in MB
opt.txCacheMB: Local cache limit for translations, in MB
opt.cacheStats: Local cache: filtering results about {mb} MB ({n} entries), translations about {txmb} MB ({txn} entries).
opt.savedRejudge: Saved. Open pages will re-check with the new settings.
opt.keyOk: Connected ({model}). The sample “{sample}” scored {score} for steering readers elsewhere.
opt.txLang: Translations go into the language your X, Reddit or YouTube interface uses (the same language X translates into); change it in each site's settings. On RedNote and Hacker News they follow your browser's language.
opt.fallback: Fallback model (used when the main one fails; can be left empty)
opt.modelHint: Default is GPT-6 Luna: on real home-feed posts translated into Chinese it beat Grok most often and was never worse, at about 0.004 cents per post; DeepSeek V4.1 Flash is the fastest and serves as the fallback. Models whose reasoning can't be turned off (such as Gemini 3.8 Flash or Claude Sonnet 5.5) don't work.
opt.txThreshold: Retranslate when Grok's score is below
opt.txMargin: Replace only if the new score is higher by at least
opt.confirmClear: Clear all stats, records of hidden replies and your corrections? This can't be undone. (The spam you marked is deleted separately in its list above.)
set.bannerRatio: Spam share in the first replies
set.errModel: {name} should look like vendor/model, e.g. openai/gpt-6-luna.
pop.txFillOnly: No Jev key: on X it only translates replies X left untranslated
pop.alert.noKey: No Jev key yet: only the local rules run, so most spam gets through.
pop.alert.badKey: Your Jev key isn't working, so replies can't be checked.
pop.alert.orCredit: OpenRouter is out of credit, so translation has stopped.
pop.alert.orBadKey: Your OpenRouter key isn't working, so translation has stopped.
pop.hereCleanTx: This page: nothing to hide, {tx} translated.
pop.hereOther: Nothing to do on this page. Hiding works on posts, other people's profiles and search results; translations are improved on Home, profiles, search results and posts.
opt.foldHint: Every site uses these by default; to change one site, open it above. Click a hidden item to read it; if it was a wrong call, say so on its notice bar.
opt.spamHint: Bots, lead generation and ads posing as ordinary comments. Stricter hides more, and hides more normal replies by mistake: among 1,411 normal replies to popular X posts in 11 languages, Relaxed wrongly hid 6, Standard 9 and Strict 19.
opt.custom: Using a custom value, {v} (change it under Advanced).
opt.m1Hint: The reply @-mentions an account that hasn't appeared in the thread, has no image or video, and its text is no longer than {n} Chinese characters (about {m} letters in alphabetic scripts).
opt.dupHint: The same line (identical apart from emoji, at least as long as 6 Chinese characters, about 24 letters) posted by several accounts under one post within 6 hours. Applies to that post only.
opt.fillerHint: Replies of just a few words — praise, agreement, thanks, “+1” — with no image or link. They’re hidden entirely; a line at the top of the comments shows them again.
opt.translateFillHint: On an X post page: when X translated the post but not the author's own replies (follow-ups, thread posts), translate those too, with a way back to the original. Needs only the OpenRouter key.
opt.jevHint: Checks replies, comments and posts for spam, abuse and sexual content. Anything the local rules can decide isn't sent.
opt.orHint: For translation: called only when Grok's translation is judged poor, to fill in a missing one, or to translate on Reddit, YouTube, RedNote and Hacker News.
opt.cost: This month: Jev {jev}, translation {or}. At the last 7 days' pace, about {month} a month.
opt.fact1: Replies the local rules catch are never uploaded.
opt.fact2: Other comments (up to 600 characters each, with the commenter's display name and handle), together with the post text (first 400 characters) and the post's author, are sent to TypeSafe (api.typesafe.ai) for scoring. The same comment isn't sent again within 7 days.
opt.fact3: Translation: for posts X has translated, the original and Grok's translation are sent to Jev for scoring. Text that needs retranslating or translating (including on Reddit, YouTube, Xiaohongshu and Hacker News) is sent to OpenRouter (openrouter.ai), which passes it to the translation model (OpenAI by default, DeepSeek as fallback; changeable under Advanced). A retranslation is also sent to Jev, to compare it with Grok's.
opt.fact4: Your keys, stats, corrections and the spam you marked stay in this browser only, as do the caches of scores and translations. Scores are deleted after 7 days, translations once unused for 30 days.
opt.fact5: With images on, images in replies (shrunk) go to TypeSafe too.
opt.advHint: Lower numbers hide more. Changes apply right away.
opt.m1MaxLen: Length limit for "short replies that only @ a stranger" (1 = one Chinese character or about 4 letters)
opt.m1: Short replies that only @ a stranger
pop.hereOtherReddit: Nothing to do on this page. On Reddit, posts, feeds and search results are filtered and translated.
pop.hereOtherHN: The extension doesn't handle this page. On Hacker News it hides abusive and sexual comments on story pages and translates foreign-language text; on lists it translates titles.
pop.hereOtherYT: The extension doesn't handle this page. On YouTube it hides spam, abusive and sexual comments on video pages and translates foreign-language titles, descriptions and comments.
pop.hereOtherXHS: The extension doesn't handle this page. On RedNote it hides spam, abusive and sexual comments under notes and translates foreign-language titles, notes and comments.
pop.unsupportedHint: ClearFlow works only on these sites:
pop.reload: Reload this page for it to take effect.
opt.foldOn.x: Replies under posts, and posts on other people's profiles and in search results.
opt.foldOn.reddit: Comments under posts, plus posts in feeds, subreddits and search results.
opt.foldOn.hn: Comments under posts, abusive and sexual ones only: spam on Hacker News is handled by moderators and flags, and almost everything the extension would hide as spam is fine there (sharing your own project or a source link is normal). Abuse is hidden one level stricter than you set.
opt.txOn.x: For posts X translated automatically (Home, profiles, search results, posts), Jev checks Grok's translation first; it's redone only if it's poor, and swapped in only if clearly better, marked "Improved translation" with a way back to Grok's. Needs both keys.
opt.txOn.reddit: Titles, posts and comments in another language are translated in place, with a way back to the original. Needs only the OpenRouter key.
opt.txOn.yt: Video titles, descriptions and comments in another language are translated in place, with a way back to the original. Needs only the OpenRouter key.
opt.txOn.xhs: Card titles, notes and comments in another language are translated in place, with a way back to the original. Needs only the OpenRouter key.
opt.txOn.hn: Titles in lists, and posts and comments on post pages, are translated in place, with a way back to the original. Needs only the OpenRouter key.
welcome.title: Get started with ClearFlow
welcome.sitesNote: You can change all of this in Settings at any time.
welcome.keysIntro: Cleaning and translation use two paid services, billed by usage.
welcome.jevNote: Needed for cleaning. Without it only local rules run, and most spam gets through.
welcome.orNote: Needed for translation. On X, translation also uses Jev.
welcome.doneText: Open a post on these sites: junk in the comments gets cleaned up, and posts in other languages get translated into yours.
welcome.doneNone: No site is turned on yet. Go back a step to turn one on, or do it later in Settings.
welcome.doneNoKey: No Jev key yet, so cleaning uses local rules only. You can add it in Settings any time.
welcome.donePopup: Click the toolbar icon to see what was cleaned on a page, or to turn it off.
